summary: In San Francisco, CA, San Francisco – Drought Resilience Matrix is a monitoring and adaptive management initiative. The program uses internal planning tool, cross-departmental use. The case addresses drought and Water Supply. Available materials report the creation of the Drought Resilience Matrix to evaluate water supply alternatives in Urban Areas, and The study concluded that while no solution is perfect, local, diversified supply options tend to be the most robust under prolonged drought conditions.
